description.en: Nominal authority in the Egyptian-held enclave around Gaza; claimed all of Palestine. After October 1948 it held no territory.
description.ar: سلطة اسمية في الجيب الخاضع لمصر حول غزة؛ ادعت السلطة على كامل فلسطين. وبعد تشرين الأول/أكتوبر 1948 لم تكن تحكم أي أرض.
description.he: סמכות שמית במובלעת שבשליטת מצרים סביב עזה; טענה לכל פלשתינה. לאחר אוקטובר 1948 לא החזיקה בשום שטח.

sources.quote: Indeed, by the end of October no members of the All-Palestine Government remained in Gaza.

In September 1948, the Arab Higher Committee in Gaza proclaimed the formation of the All-Palestine Government, headed by Ahmad Hilmi Abd al-Baqi, with the support of Egypt and the non-Hashemite Arab countries.
Haj Amin presided over the Palestine National Council, held in Gaza, which confirmed the legality of that government.
22 Eylül 1948’de Şam’da toplanan el-Lecnetü’l-Arabiyyetü’l-ulyâ li-Filistîn, Kudüs şehri merkez olmak üzere bir Filistin devletinin kurulduğunu ve Gazze’nin geçici merkez kabul edildiğini açıkladı.
sources.note: 'On 22 September 1948 the Arab Higher Committee for Palestine, meeting in Damascus [sic; Shlaim and PalQuest place it in Gaza], announced the establishment of a Palestinian state with Jerusalem as its centre and Gaza as its provisional seat.'

notes.en: Overlaps the Egyptian administration of Gaza (client relation).
notes.ar: يتداخل مع الإدارة المصرية لغزة (علاقة تبعية).
